title: Ember Shift: Void Relay
summary: A high-stakes survival game in a collapsing nebula. Shift between dimensions to bypass unstable matter.
instructions: WASD or Arrow keys move the player through the arena., Shift triggers a sprint burst for repositioning., Space converts root and petal pressure into crowd control.

hud.objective: Complete objectives, resolve enemy pressure, route hazards, and trigger the finish condition.
